notes.title: Curyeux is Steam Deck compatible
notes.content:
Curyeux is played on the Steam Deck


The game will automatically choose the "medium" graphics quality option without dynamic shadows to achieve more than sixty frames per second, but the player can choose the "high" option to play at around thirty frames per second.

Note that at level four, it is currently preferable to play at "high" to see better in the shadows.
